item.title: Brewer’s thrilling rivalry win against Bangor punctuated by disagreement over score
item.description: The Bangor-Brewer rivalry is more than a century old, and players on both boys basketball teams did that storied history proud Tuesday night.

item.description: A Christmas Eve Powerball drawing could add new meaning to holiday cheer as millions of players hope to cash in on the $1.7 billion prize, which comes after months without a jackpot winner. item.title: I’m the only founding member going to this deer camp 55 years later
item.description: "A poet, whose name escapes me, likened these remote, sometimes tar-papered shacks, to 'palaces in the popple.'"

item.title: Milford family honors late grandmother with ‘display of misfit decorations’
item.description: For nearly a decade, the LeBlanc family in Milford has kept up a decades-old tradition of transforming their home off the County Road into a massive Christmas lights spectacle for the community.

item.title: Easy-to-make holiday cookies your dog will love
item.description: While I have limited knowledge about baking, I do know a thing or two about my dog — what he likes, what he doesn’t like, and the things he shouldn’t eat.

item.title: A Maine cop warned of interpreter fraud 5 years ago. The state is just catching up.
item.description: A federal investigator warned Maine officials about possible interpreter fraud schemes in a 2020 report that has not been disclosed until now. The findings come on the heels of fraud allegations against a major health care provider serving immigrants.

item.title: These are the hurdles to combining Aroostook’s 3 largest high schools
item.description: Location, transportation and loss of local identity are just some of the challenges the budget-driven proposal faces.

item.title: Recycling returning to Greater Bangor communities in 2026

item.title: Niche businesses flourished in Aroostook this year
item.description: The County lost some chain stores, but openings outweighed closures overall in northern Maine, and niche small businesses generated a buzz.
